SMTO-LLM-0040 — The model server isn't offering any models

GUID: 7b838d2d-0004-469a-a756-63826836d877
Slug: model-discovery-empty
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: llm

What happened

  • The model server answered, but its list didn't name any model SMTO could use, so SMTO had nothing to pick automatically. No question was sent to the model.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. On the model server, make sure the model has finished loading and is being served. Large models can take several minutes to load. A server lists a model only once it is loaded and ready to answer.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing, expand Main, and confirm the Endpoint points to the server where the model is loaded. Pointing at a different server, or the wrong address on it, can return an empty list.
  3. Select Check saved model, or turn off Auto-select model and select Discover models. This asks the server for its list again so you can see the model appear.

What success looks like

  • Discover models shows your model, and new work starts normally.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who runs the model server. Don't type in a model name the server doesn't list; requests for it will fail.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The selected endpoint's /models response contained no usable model entries (no id, name or model field), so automatic model selection had nothing to choose.

What this means

  • Discovery completed without a usable model entry, so automatic selection has no concrete identity to choose. This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Discovery completed without a usable model entry, so automatic selection has no concrete identity to choose.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the returned inventory with the serving process's loaded models; a loaded model omitted by the API points to a discovery configuration issue.

How to fix it

  • Load or enable the model on the serving endpoint and confirm its /models response lists it with an id (checked in NativeToolCallLLMClient._served_models, src/agent_runtime/llm/native_tool_client.py). Then refresh with Discover models or Check saved model; do not configure a model name the endpoint does not serve.
  • Load or enable the intended model on the serving endpoint, then refresh the model list. Do not select an invented model identity.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A refreshed model list exposes the intended identity and model selection succeeds.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
